description.value: Bicycle Pizza is a small-but-mighty pop-up pizza operation serving hand-tossed, thin-crust pizzas at events, markets, and community celebrations around greater Victoria. They hold regular weekly spots at Junction Orchard + Cidery and offer full catering with pizza, brunch, charcuterie, and sweet carts. Recognized by enRoute magazine as 2022 Best New Takeout, they are a beloved local operation with deep Island roots.
